data.one_liner: Interactive drill-down maps of Bangladesh from division to union.
data.what_it_does: Provides interactive maps of Bangladesh with support for drilling down from divisions to districts, upazilas, and unions. Includes a geography API for boundary and hierarchy lookups, and supports coloring regions using JSON or API data.
use_when: You need to display maps of Bangladesh with region-level interactions.
You want to visualize regional data like population or statistics using choropleth maps.
You need a pure Dart solution with zero external asset or plugin dependencies.
avoid_when: You need general global maps or street navigation (use Google Maps or flutter_map instead).
You require real-time GPS tracking or geolocation features.
strengths: Pure Dart with no external dependencies or assets required.
Supports deep drill-down mapping from division down to union level.
Built-in geography API with English and Bangla names and boundaries.
weaknesses: Restricted exclusively to geographical data for Bangladesh.
Does not support general interactive pan/zoom free-form vector mapping for other countries.
data.minimal_example:
BdMap(
  onRegionTap: (region) => print(region.name),
  infoBuilder: (context, region) => Text('${region.name} · ${region.bnName}'),
)
